outcome: Specific severe maternal morbidity indicators (disseminated intravascular coagulation, eclampsia, heart failure, internal injuries, intracranial injuries, pulmonary edema, thrombotic embolism, blood transfusion)
cohort: 19,658 infertile women and 525,695 fertile women who underwent pregnancy and delivery of a singleton
finding: Women diagnosed with infertility or receiving fertility treatment have a significantly higher risk of experiencing severe maternal morbidity, including specific complications like disseminated intravascular coagulation, eclampsia, and thrombotic embolism, compared to fertile women.
